card.name: Section names inside cross-reference brackets
card.fires_on: Words inside a label cross-reference such as [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1)], especially the next section-title word after "see". Fires mostly where the text is oddly split or spaced.

modes.label: Cross-reference titles
modes.description: The word that begins or continues a section title after "[see", e.g. Warnings, Clinical, Drug, in.

modes.label: Split-up spelling
modes.description: Part of a section title where the word is broken by stray spaces, such as W arnings or Inter actions.

modes.label: Other headings
modes.description: Occasional capitalized words starting a heading or name outside cross-references.
